name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement canonical quantum amplitude estimat
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement canonical quantum amplitude estimation in Qiskit with 5 evaluation qubits: the state preparation A = RY(2.552544) encodes amplitude sin^2(2.552544/2), build the Grover operator Q manually, run QPE, and compare the estimate with the true amplitude. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
